name: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd
title: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd - 540025 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 22% YoY to INR 2,034m with EBITDA margin steady at 31%, but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance, capacity expansion is deferred to September, and US demand is weak.

utilisation.quote: we do have infrastructure to increase the capacity increment by 50% right away

capex.quote: In the main company, we will be taking that call after September.

triggers.label: Main-company capacity call deferred to September
triggers.quote: In the main company, we will be taking that call after September.

triggers.label: Pricing constant; cost pass-through from New Year
triggers.quote: In terms of pricing, the pricing is more or less constant.

triggers.label: US expected to grow little in FY27
triggers.quote: we expect little growth coming from the U.S., and not like the negative growth.

triggers.label: Inventory build for supply security
triggers.quote: sometimes you need to build up the capacity, build up the inventories to manage all the changing global environments.
